checks.title: Mobile default AppConfig.baseUrl & aiServiceUrl point to unrouted hosts (api.canadev.my.id / ai.canadev.my.id)
checks.summary: Default URLs returned api=404, ai=404 instead of 200 OK on api-server / ai-server
checks.userImpact: Every standard APK build (`flutter build apk` / `flutter run` without `--dart-define`) fails to connect to Backend or AI Service.

checks.title: Mobile default AppConfig.aiApiKey rejected by AI Service POST /v1/verify & /v1/predict-risk
checks.summary: AI Service rejected Mobile default X-API-Key (laporkita_sec_e6...) with HTTP 403
checks.expectedContract: HTTP 200 OK (matching INTERNAL_API_KEY between Mobile AppConfig and AI Service)

error.message: Akses ditolak: API Key yang diberikan tidak valid.

checks.userImpact: Citizen camera AI verification (AiVerificationScreen) and dashboard flood risk prediction (CitizenDashboardTab) always fail with 403 Forbidden unless overridden at compile time.

checks.title: Backend auto-transitions blurry/OOD (bukan_fasilitas) and tampered reports to status="verified" instead of manual review
checks.summary: Blurry/OOD image (AI /v1/verify predicted_category="bukan_fasilitas", is_valid=false, needs_manual_review=true) was auto-approved by Backend to status="verified", needs_manual_review=false, ai_confidence_score=0.9999

aiCompatVerifyData.reason: Perlu review manual: Citra terklasifikasi sebagai bukan fasilitas publik.
aiCompatVerifyData.verified_address: Jl. Merdeka / Jl. Ijen / Jl. Semeru, Kecamatan Klojen, Kota Malang

checks.userImpact: Junk, blurry, non-facility (bukan_fasilitas), and digitally tampered photos submitted to Backend bypass human moderation, automatically transition to verified, and award +10 citizen contribution points.

checks.title: Backend PolicySimulatorService bypasses AI Service POST /v1/policy-simulate and returns hardcoded static resultData without recommendations
checks.summary: Backend hardcodes resultData={reduction:35, budget:450000000, months:6} and omits recommendations, while AI /v1/policy-simulate computes dynamic reduction=55%, budget=4800000000, key_recommendations[3]
checks.expectedContract: Backend calls AI Service POST /v1/policy-simulate (or /api/v1/policy-simulate) and persists structured recommendations, dynamic budget, and simulated risk score matching PolicySimulationModel.fromJson.

risk_factors: Curah hujan tinggi pada musim penghujan

aiServiceResultData.target_department: Dinas Pekerjaan Umum, Penataan Ruang, Perumahan dan Kawasan Permukiman (DPUPRPKP) Kota Malang
risk_mitigations: Sosialisasi jadwal dan dampak proyek secara berkala kepada masyarakat terdampak
Manajemen lalu lintas dan penyediaan jalur alternatif selama masa konstruksi
Koordinasi dengan Dinas Lingkungan Hidup untuk pengelolaan sampah dan sedimen hasil pengerukan

checks.userImpact: Command Center Policy Simulator always shows static 35% reduction, Rp 450M budget, 3.2 risk score, and 0 recommended actions regardless of policy prompt or zone.

checks.title: AdminAssignReportScreen agency assignment: Mobile drops assignedAgencyId and Backend rejects assigned_agency_id on PATCH /reports/{id}/status
checks.summary: Sending assigned_agency_id to PATCH /reports/{id}/status failed with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR: ["property assigned_agency_id should not exist"]
checks.expectedContract: TransitionStatusDto accepts optional assigned_agency_id UUID and updates report.assigned_agency_id

error.message: Input tidak valid. Periksa field yang dikirim.

checks.userImpact: Admin OPD reassignment in AdminAssignReportScreen never updates report.assigned_agency_id in the database; only free-text note is saved.

checks.title: AdminVerificationActionScreen "Meminta Revisi" sends status="pending_verification" -> rejected with 409 CONFLICT by Backend
checks.summary: PATCH status="pending_verification" returned 409 (INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: Tidak dapat mengubah status dari 'verified' ke 'pending_verification'. Alur yang diperbolehkan dari 'verified' adalah: [assigned] (Rules.md §1.1).)
checks.expectedContract: Dedicated revision action/comment or valid transition saving the admin revision note

error.message: INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: Tidak dapat mengubah status dari 'verified' ke 'pending_verification'. Alur yang diperbolehkan dari 'verified' adalah: [assigned] (Rules.md §1.1).

checks.userImpact: Backend rejects the revision request with 409 CONFLICT, while Mobile ReportRepository swallows the error and shows a fake success SnackBar without saving the revision note.

checks.title: NewReportFormScreen fallback categories ("cat-sampah" / "Sampah & Kebersihan") rejected by Backend (400) and AI Service (422)
checks.summary: Backend rejected category_id="cat-sampah" with 400 (category_id harus berupa UUID yang valid.), AI rejected claimed_category="Sampah & Kebersihan" with 422
checks.expectedContract: Fallback categories in NewReportFormScreen use valid seed UUIDs (c1000000-...-0001..5) and canonical 5 category names

backendError.message: Input tidak valid. Periksa field yang dikirim.
details: category_id harus berupa UUID yang valid.

aiError.message: body: Value error, Kategori 'Sampah & Kebersihan' tidak valid. Harus salah satu dari: Jalan Berlubang, Lampu Jalan, Rambu Lalu Lintas, Trotoar, Drainase, bukan_fasilitas

details.msg: Value error, Kategori 'Sampah & Kebersihan' tidak valid. Harus salah satu dari: Jalan Berlubang, Lampu Jalan, Rambu Lalu Lintas, Trotoar, Drainase, bukan_fasilitas

checks.userImpact: If GET /categories fails or User picks a non-matching fallback category in NewReportFormScreen, report submission fails with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

checks.title: ImageUtils.compressIfNeeded skips files < 900KB without transcoding WebP, causing Backend FileValidationPipe 400 rejection
checks.summary: <900KB WebP (620 bytes) named report_photo.jpg rejected with 400: Tipe file tidak diizinkan. Hanya JPEG dan PNG yang diterima (Rules.md §2.1). Periksa bahwa file bukan WebP, GIF, atau file berekstensi berbeda dari isinya.
checks.expectedContract: ImageUtils transcodes non-JPEG/PNG files even if <900KB, OR Backend FileValidationPipe accepts WebP as documented in Swagger

error.message: Tipe file tidak diizinkan. Hanya JPEG dan PNG yang diterima (Rules.md §2.1). Periksa bahwa file bukan WebP, GIF, atau file berekstensi berbeda dari isinya.

checks.userImpact: Gallery uploads of WebP/HEIC images under 900 KB bypass FlutterImageCompress, get labeled report_photo.jpg, and are rejected by Backend magic-byte check.

checks.title: Malang BBox divergence: Ring-Zone coordinate (-8.15, 112.60) fails AI /v1/verify (gps_valid=false) but passes Backend POST /reports (202)
checks.summary: Coordinate (-8.15, 112.60) returned gps_valid=false on AI /v1/verify (blocking Mobile "Lanjut" button) while Backend POST /reports accepted it with 202
checks.expectedContract: Identical Malang bounding box across AI Service and Backend
checks.userImpact: Citizens in outer Malang ring areas ([-8.25,-8.05] or [-7.90,-7.85]) are blocked by Mobile AiVerificationScreen even though Backend considers their coordinates valid.

checks.title: QueryReportsDto boolean implicit conversion trap: GET /reports?needsManualReview=false filters for needs_manual_review=true
checks.summary: GET /reports?needsManualReview=false returned 2 reports where 100% have needs_manual_review=true (identical to ?needsManualReview=true)
checks.userImpact: Passing needsManualReview=false (or needs_manual_review=false) returns only manual-review reports because @Type(() => Boolean) runs Boolean("false") === true.

checks.title: ReportDetailScreen._handleSupport calls repo.supportReport AND ReportSupportRequested -> duplicate POST /support 409
checks.summary: First support call returned 201, immediate second call from ReportBloc returned 409 (CONFLICT)
checks.expectedContract: Single POST /reports/{id}/support dispatch per user tap (and ReportConfirmationScreen option 0 actually calling supportReport)

secondCallError.message: ALREADY_SUPPORTED: Anda sudah memberikan dukungan untuk laporan ini (Rules.md §1.4).

checks.userImpact: Every support tap in ReportDetailScreen fires a redundant 409 request (and ReportDetailScreen._handleAdminStatusChange at lines 1273 & 1285 similarly fires duplicate PATCH /status).

checks.title: FcmService.initialize calls POST /route-alerts/subscribe on cold boot before authentication -> 401 UNAUTHORIZED
checks.expectedContract: FcmService only registers route-alert token after AuthAuthenticated state is established
checks.userImpact: Unauthenticated cold starts always fail FCM token registration with 401 Unauthorized.

checks.title: PredictionRemoteDatasource.getZoneMetrics returns empty [] because Backend wraps metrics in {zone, metrics} Map
checks.summary: Backend returned 20 metrics inside data={zone, metrics}, but PredictionRemoteDatasource.getZoneMetrics parsed 0 items
checks.expectedContract: List of 20 ZoneMetricsModel items unwrapped from json['metrics']
checks.userImpact: Zone historical risk metrics are 100% dropped by Mobile PredictionRemoteDatasource.

checks.title: Backend POST /maps/route & RouteModel.fromBackendMapsJson drop OSRM steps[] and summary, breaking turn-by-turn TTS
checks.summary: Parsed RouteModel has polylinePoints=213, steps=0, summary=""
checks.expectedContract: Non-empty steps[] (RouteStep maneuver instructions) and street summary from OSRM
checks.userImpact: Active navigation banner and TtsService cannot announce street-level turn maneuvers because steps is always empty [].

checks.title: AiVerificationResult.fromJson reads json["reason"] which is absent on POST /v1/verify (text is in description_auto)
checks.summary: On OOD & out-of-Malang responses, AiVerificationResult.rejectionReason is null while autoDescription="Citra teridentifikasi bukan merupakan kerusakan fasilitas publik (bukan_fasilitas)."
checks.expectedContract: rejectionReason populated on invalid/manual-review verification responses

actualObserved.oodAutoDescription: Citra teridentifikasi bukan merupakan kerusakan fasilitas publik (bukan_fasilitas).

checks.title: ReportRemoteDatasource.submitReport manual ReportModel reconstruction drops rawAiConfidenceScore, damageSeverity, estimatedCompletionAt
checks.summary: ReportModel.fromJson parsed rawAiConfidenceScore=0.9998, damageSeverity=0.9599, but submitReport reconstruction resets them to null
checks.expectedContract: submitReport preserves all ReportModel fields via copyWith(localPhotoPath: filePath)
checks.userImpact: Locally cached submitted reports lose server-returned AI confidence, severity, and SLA fields until re-fetched.

checks.title: Backend AuthService passes array messages on OTP errors, causing HttpExceptionFilter to overwrite OTP_* codes with VALIDATION_ERROR
checks.summary: verify-otp wrong code returned error.code="VALIDATION_ERROR" (expected OTP_INVALID) and resend-otp cooldown returned error.code="VALIDATION_ERROR" (expected OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN with remainingSeconds)

verifyOtpError.message: Input tidak valid. Periksa field yang dikirim.
details: Kode OTP yang Anda masukkan salah.

resendOtpError.message: Input tidak valid. Periksa field yang dikirim.
details: Kirim ulang kode OTP sedang dalam cooldown. Tunggu 43 detik lagi.

checks.userImpact: Mobile ApiException cannot distinguish OTP_EXPIRED / OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS / OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN by error.code and loses remainingSeconds countdown metadata.

checks.title: AI Service POST /v1/training/ingest-sample returns un-sanitized target_category ("Jalan Berlubang"), which 404s on GET /v1/training/samples/{class_name}/{filename}
